summary: Harness-neutral question forms, settled summaries and needs-you attention surfaces

replay.detail: Presentation-only changes do not change replay or recovery triggers.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: New typed UI props and recorded tool-question presentation do not change wire protocols or harness version admission. The generic tool seam remains read-only; applications own terminal navigation and any web-answer capability.

downtime.detail: No additional service restart or interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no migration or state-changing operator action.

recovery.detail: No stored state is changed and no additional runtime recovery procedure is required.
